pitch.en: The team practiced on a wet pitch after the rain stopped.
pitch.zh: 雨停後，球隊在潮濕的球場上練習。

pitcher.en: The pitcher threw carefully during the final inning of the game.
pitcher.zh: 那名投手在比賽最後一局小心投球。

pm.en: The library closes at nine pm on most weekdays.
pm.zh: 圖書館大多數平日晚上九點關門。

pneumonia.en: The health article explains why pneumonia can require professional medical care.
pneumonia.zh: 健康文章說明為什麼肺炎可能需要專業醫療照護。

politician.en: The article describes how a politician answered questions from local reporters.
politician.zh: 文章描述一名政治人物如何回答地方記者的問題。

politics.en: Our civics class studies politics through laws, elections, and public institutions.
politics.zh: 我們的公民課透過法律、選舉與公共制度來學習政治。

poll.en: The class conducted a poll about students' preferred study methods.
poll.zh: 班上進行一項關於學生偏好讀書方法的民調。

pray.en: Some visitors pray quietly inside the historic place of worship.
pray.zh: 有些訪客在這座歷史宗教場所內安靜祈禱。

prayer.en: The museum display includes a written prayer from an earlier century.
prayer.zh: 博物館展品包含一篇來自較早世紀的祈禱文。

preach.en: The lesson explains how religious leaders may preach to their communities.
preach.zh: 課堂說明宗教領袖可能如何向其社群講道。

pregnancy.en: The textbook discusses pregnancy as part of human biology and health education.
pregnancy.zh: 課本把懷孕作為人體生物與健康教育的一部分來討論。

pregnant.en: The biology lesson explains changes that can occur when someone is pregnant.
pregnant.zh: 生物課說明懷孕時可能出現的身體變化。

preside.en: A senior student will preside over the club meeting tomorrow.
preside.zh: 一位高年級學生明天將主持社團會議。

presidency.en: The history chapter examines several major events during his presidency.
presidency.zh: 歷史章節探討他擔任總統期間的幾項重大事件。

president.en: The club president opened the meeting with a short welcome.
president.zh: 社長以簡短歡迎詞開始會議。

presidential.en: The article compares different presidential systems in several countries.
presidential.zh: 文章比較數個國家的不同總統制。

prevention.en: The campaign focuses on prevention through education and early awareness.
prevention.zh: 這項活動著重透過教育與及早認識來進行預防。

preventive.en: The brochure describes preventive health measures in general terms.
preventive.zh: 這份手冊以一般方式介紹預防性的健康措施。

priest.en: A priest explained the history of the old church to visitors.
priest.zh: 一位神父向訪客介紹這座老教堂的歷史。

prison.en: The documentary examines how prison systems differ across countries.
prison.zh: 紀錄片探討不同國家的監獄制度有何差異。

prisoner.en: The history book describes a prisoner who later became a writer.
prisoner.zh: 歷史書描述一名後來成為作家的囚犯。

prohibition.en: The sign explains the prohibition of parking near the emergency entrance.
prohibition.zh: 標示說明緊急入口附近禁止停車。

propaganda.en: The class learned to identify propaganda by checking sources and evidence.
propaganda.zh: 班上學習透過查核來源與證據來辨識宣傳資訊。

prophet.en: The course discusses the role of a prophet in several traditions.
prophet.zh: 這門課討論先知在不同傳統中的角色。

prosecute.en: The article explains when authorities may prosecute a case under the law.
prosecute.zh: 文章說明主管機關在法律下何時可能提起訴訟。

prosecution.en: The report summarizes the evidence presented during the prosecution of the case.
prosecution.zh: 報告摘要整理該案件起訴期間提出的證據。

protest.en: Students studied how peaceful protest has influenced social change in history.
protest.zh: 學生研究和平抗議在歷史上如何影響社會變遷。

psychiatry.en: The article introduces psychiatry as a field of medicine and research.
psychiatry.zh: 文章介紹精神醫學作為一個醫學與研究領域。

psychic.en: The novel includes a psychic character who claims to predict events.
psychic.zh: 小說中有一名自稱能預測事件的靈媒角色。

psychological.en: The study examines psychological factors that influence learning and memory.
psychological.zh: 這項研究探討影響學習與記憶的心理因素。

psychologist.en: A psychologist spoke to students about how researchers study human behavior.
psychologist.zh: 一位心理學家向學生介紹研究者如何研究人類行為。

psychotherapy.en: The textbook defines psychotherapy as one form of professional mental health care.
psychotherapy.zh: 課本將心理治療定義為一種專業心理健康照護。

punish.en: The teacher prefers to explain mistakes rather than punish students immediately.
punish.zh: 老師偏好先解釋錯誤，而不是立刻處罰學生。

racial.en: The lesson examines how racial discrimination has affected societies in history.
racial.zh: 課堂探討種族歧視在歷史上如何影響社會。

racism.en: The class discussed why racism harms fairness and equal treatment.
racism.zh: 班上討論為什麼種族主義會傷害公平與平等待遇。

radiate.en: The diagram shows how waves radiate outward from a central source.
radiate.zh: 圖表顯示波如何從中央來源向外輻射。

radiation.en: The science lesson compares different forms of radiation in nature.
radiation.zh: 自然科學課比較自然界中不同形式的輻射。

radioactive.en: The textbook explains what makes certain materials radioactive in scientific terms.
radioactive.zh: 課本以科學方式說明某些材料為何具有放射性。

radius.en: Measure the radius before calculating the area of the circle.
radius.zh: 計算圓面積前先量半徑。

rag.en: An old rag was used as a prop in the play.
rag.zh: 一塊舊布被當作戲劇道具使用。

rage.en: The novel shows how uncontrolled rage can damage important relationships.
rage.zh: 小說呈現失控的憤怒如何傷害重要關係。

ragged.en: The hikers followed a ragged path along the rocky hillside.
ragged.zh: 健行者沿著岩石山坡上一條崎嶇小徑前進。

raid.en: The history exhibit describes a raid without showing graphic details.
raid.zh: 歷史展覽描述一次突襲，但沒有呈現血腥細節。

republican.en: In political theory, republican can describe ideas centered on a republic.
republican.zh: 在政治理論中，republican 可描述以共和國為核心的理念。

reputation.en: The school built a strong reputation for science education over many years.
reputation.zh: 這所學校多年來建立了良好的科學教育聲譽。

rescue.en: The training video explains how a rescue team coordinates during emergencies.
rescue.zh: 訓練影片說明救援隊在緊急事件中如何協調。

resemblance.en: The two designs show a clear resemblance despite their different colors.
resemblance.zh: 這兩個設計雖然顏色不同，但有明顯相似之處。

resemble.en: These clouds resemble waves when viewed from a distance.
resemble.zh: 這些雲從遠處看很像波浪。

reservoir.en: The reservoir stores water that supports nearby communities during dry periods.
reservoir.zh: 這座水庫儲存供附近社區乾季使用的水。

reside.en: Many bird species reside in the wetlands throughout the year.
reside.zh: 許多鳥類全年棲息在這片濕地。
